books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.description: An excellent guide to the principles, architecture, and trade-offs of modern data systems. Covers storage engines, replication, partitioning, transactions, and distributed consensus.

books.title: Clean Architecture
books.author: Robert C. Martin
books.description: A handbook of software structure and design, presenting the universal rules of software architecture and explaining how to build robust, maintainable systems.

books.title: Site Reliability Engineering
books.author: Betsy Beyer, Chris Jones, Jennifer Petoff, Niall Richard Murphy
books.description: How Google runs production systems. Explains the engineering and O&M practices that enable Google to build, deploy, monitor, and maintain some of the largest software systems in the world.

articles.title: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters
articles.author: Jeffrey Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat (Google)
articles.description: The seminal paper describing a programming model and an associated implementation for processing and generating large data sets on distributed clusters.

articles.title: Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store
articles.author: Giuseppe DeCandia et al. (Amazon)
articles.description: Introduced the design of Dynamo, a highly available and scalable key-value storage system that powers many of Amazon's core services, popularizing decentralized databases.

articles.title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm (Raft)
articles.author: Diego Ongaro and John Ousterhout (Stanford)
articles.description: Introduced the Raft consensus algorithm, designed as an alternative to Paxos to be easier to understand, implement, and reason about in distributed systems.
